structure._comment: Maintainability limits. Differential by default: a violation is reported only when this change introduced or worsened it, so existing debt is not blamed on the current edit. Set greenfield:true on a new project to make the limits absolute.

custom.name: no_network_in_core
custom.message: The verification core must never reach the network. See RULES.md section 4.

refactor._comment: Structural integrity of a refactor: a renamed definition must not leave call sites behind.

zones.name: verification_core
zones.reason: The core must stay dependency-free and must never reach the network or an adapter. See RULES.md section 4.

zones.name: adapters
zones.reason: Adapters depend only on the verdict API, never on core internals. See RULES.md section 2, Interface Segregation.

linters._comment: Off by default. Findings from external tools are advisory and can never block an edit; see RULES.md section 4. Run 'aegisflow linters' to list available tools.
